name: moida
description: AI 작업 세션을 모아 그래프로 키우고 블로그 글로 쓰는 self-hosted 블로그 엔진

scripts.db:new: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint dbmate migrate --migrations-dir /db/migrations new
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build db migrate
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm boundaries && pnpm structure && pnpm deadcode
scripts.structure: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && node scripts/check-rules.mjs && node scripts/check-skills.mjs
scripts.plugin: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin plugin
scripts.install-code: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin install-code
scripts.owner: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin owner
scripts.restore: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin restore
scripts.events: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin events
scripts.secret:rotate: docker compose exec -T server moida-admin secret rotate
